metadata.title: Density Pass 25 -- Day 3 Morning Gap Fill (Ticks 451-505)
metadata.description: The morning of July 3 before the cannonade. XII Corps reclaiming Culp's Hill. Meade's 9 AM council of war. Lee deciding on the grand assault. Ewell's corps pinned down on the right. Longstreet arguing against the charge. Stuart leaving for the cavalry action east of town. The tense quiet before the bombardment.

placements.notes: Geary's division assault in progress at dawn -- 7 hours of fighting to reclaim the breastworks
Johnson's division defending -- losing ground slowly back up the hill
Greene's brigade -- still holding the upper works they never abandoned
Steuart's brigade giving ground -- the Baltimore Pike is not taken
Williams's division driving Johnson back -- Culp's Hill will be Union by 11 AM
Gibbon's division on Cemetery Ridge -- Meade's council just ended. They will face Pickett.
Hays's division -- they will be on Picketts left, Gibbon on the right
McLaws's division on Seminary Ridge -- Longstreet has been arguing against the assault since dawn
Pickett's division in reserve -- Longstreet told Pickett to go when Alexander signals. He cannot give the order himself.
Stuart's 4 brigades moving east -- Lee has sent him to get behind Meade and strike when Pickett charges
Gregg's Union cavalry positioning -- he has spotted Stuart. Custer will charge.
Johnson's division losing the works -- Ewell can no longer threaten the Union right
Geary's XII Corps reclaiming the works -- Culp's Hill is being won back
Alexander moving his guns into final position -- 75 guns along Seminary Ridge
Cushing's Battery A at The Angle -- 6 guns. Cushing has been here since July 1.
Pickett's division waiting -- Longstreet pacing. Neither wants to give this order.
XII Corps -- Culp's Hill reclaimed by 11 AM. 7 hours of fighting. Union right secure.
Johnson's division on lower Culp's Hill -- repulsed. They will not attack again.
Gibbon's division -- quiet on Cemetery Ridge. The men can see the Confederate guns deploying across the valley.
Pickett's division -- Alexander is nearly ready. One hour to the cannonade.
Stuart at East Cavalry Field -- Gregg and Custer are waiting for him. The cavalry battle begins.
